sources.title: Chad entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs of the Slovak Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: Slovakia MFA's live country guidance expressly applies to Slovak citizens' ordinary travel and identifies Chad's visa requirement. Chad's newer immigration authority controls the electronic issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Občania Slovenskej republiky potrebujú k vstupu do Čadu vízum.

sources.title: New visa tariffs in the Republic of Chad
sources.publisher: Directorate of Immigration and Emigration, Republic of Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: The live evisa.td notice identifies the Directorate of Immigration and Emigration and its eVisa subdirectorate. From 11 May 2026 it requires all new non-diplomatic, non-courtesy visa requests exclusively through evisa.td.
sources.supportingExcerpt: toutes les demandes de visa se font désormais exclusivement en ligne via plateforme officielle evisa.td.

sources.title: E-Visa circular
sources.publisher: Directorate of Immigration and Emigration / E-Visa Subdirectorate, Republic of Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: The live 4 June 2026 circular from Chad's eVisa subdirectorate states standard and express electronic-visa processing periods, corroborating pre-travel electronic issuance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Demande de e-Visa standard : 10 jours ouvrables; Demande de e-Visa express: 72 heures
